I have farmed rice on this land for many years now. I will apply some inorganic fertilizer because the soil is tired, but I cannot afford too much, so I will use what I can buy from the market. I also have some cow dung from my animals that I will spread on the plot before planting. I will plant the improved seed I got from my neighbor last season because it grows well and fills the panicle better, and I will buy herbicide to spray so my children do not have to weed under the hot sun too much. This plot is small enough that my family can manage most of the work, but during harvest I will need to hire some young men from the village to help us cut and carry the rice.
